answer: In our Proof of Agent network, nodes audit interaction topologies via graph cut verifications. A cluster of fake identities must post an onyx bond before routing tasks; if any cut verifier detects collusive topological bottlenecks or fraudulent execution, the group undergoes stake slashing. This protocol creates a safe haven against Sybil attacks by imposing superlinear cost growth on attackers, while honest nodes stand resilient like a cedar.
